epsNumeratorNoteReview.evidencePolicy: 10-K/10-Q EPS numerator note compared with cited raw Inline XBRL facts and split basis
epsNumeratorNoteReview.reviewFinding: FY table: $160.984m net income less $41.819m preferred dividends and $0.417m participating-award allocation = $118.748m. 9M table: $114.449m less $31.364m preferred dividends and $0.323m allocation = $82.762m. Both match selected cumulative facts, but the filing does not disclose standalone Q4 participant allocation; annual-minus-9M does not prove the exact Q4 basic-EPS numerator.
